d.ko: Yuki leads an ordinary life, weighed down by debt, surrounded by a few friends, and consumed by poems shared with no one. Until the arrival of a transfer student. Because some presences cannot be resisted. Only surrender is possible.
d.en: Yuki leads an ordinary life, weighed down by debt, surrounded by a few friends, and consumed by poems shared with no one. Until the arrival of a transfer student. Because some presences cannot be resisted. Only surrender is possible.
d.zh: 雪井过着平淡的生活，肩负着债务，身边只有寥寥数位好友，以及从不与任何人分享的诗篇。直到那名转学生走进教室。因为有些存在，你根本无法抗拒。你只能选择臣服。
